😭💔 Bowser Jr. only wanted ONE THING for his birthday… a MOM to love him! But when Bowser tries to make his son's wish come true, he goes TOO FAR! Can Mario and Princess Peach stop his heartbreaking plan?

Bowser's castle is filled with excitement as everyone prepares an unforgettable birthday celebration for Bowser Jr.! Colorful balloons, enormous presents, a beautiful birthday cake, and wonderful surprises fill the castle. 🎂🎁

Bowser is determined to give his son the happiest birthday ever. He even prepares an incredible new kart as a special gift!

But despite all the presents and decorations, Bowser Jr. looks strangely sad. While everyone else celebrates, the little Koopa prince quietly sits alone, holding a drawing of a happy family. 😢

When Bowser asks what's wrong, his son's heartbreaking answer leaves him speechless.

All Bowser Jr. wants is a MOM to celebrate his birthday with him. ❤️

Desperate to make his son happy, Bowser promises to find him a mother. But instead of respecting other people's feelings, the powerful Koopa King comes up with a dangerous plan involving Princess Peach!

Bowser believes that if he can force Peach to become part of their family, Bowser Jr. will finally have the birthday he's always dreamed of.

But when Princess Peach discovers Bowser's shocking intentions, she refuses to cooperate! Mario soon learns about Bowser's plan and rushes to protect her. 😱🔥

Meanwhile, Bowser Jr. begins to realize that his innocent birthday wish has caused something terrible. He never wanted anyone to be hurt or forced into becoming his mother.

Now Bowser must face a difficult choice between following his selfish plan and understanding what his son truly needs.

Can Mario and Peach help Bowser Jr. find happiness without destroying someone else's freedom?
